epic.summary: Cash Settlement based on Average Price

business_context: Change FX Spot P/L calculation from FIFO to average-price (weighted average) cash settlement: per-instrument-type configuration (CRT-1741), average fill / open P/L / % P/L gross formulas (CRT-1740–1743), and weighted-average ladder for realized P/L (CRT-1738).

synthesis.problem_gist: Corner migrates FX Spot instruments from FIFO-based P/L to configurable weighted-average cash settlement, with Yogi CRT-1738–CRT-1743 defining configuration mapping, metric formulas, and ladder behavior.

impact_areas.text: Functional configuration — FIFO vs WeightedAvg per instrument family
Position metrics — average fill, open P/L, % P/L gross, realized P/L
FX Spot cash settlement / weighted-average ladders

requirements.snippet_text: Average Price, Open PL and Realized PL during cash settlement (for non-equity cash flow) are calculated by weighted average for the instrument types configured accordingly in . The Weighted Average algorithm assumes that PL for each closing trade for the whole history of a position should be calculated based on average position price and not the opening price of the matched opening trades. Only opening trades contributes to position average price. See rounding rules: for average price calculation - according to ; for realized PL - according to ; for open PL - according to . Example the following position history from the moment the position was flat (zero size): 1) BUY +10 @ 99.00 => position: long 10 2) BUY +10 @ 98.00 => position: long 20 3a) SELL -20 @ 99.50 => position: 0 3b) SELL -10 @ 99.50 => position: short 10 4) SELL -10 @ 98.50 => position: short 20 5a) BUY +10 @ 97.25 => position: short 10 5b) BUY +15 @ 98 => position: long 5 6) BUY +10 @ 99.50 => position: long 15 Ask = 99 Bid = 97 Average price and PL calculations for each point: Trade sequence Trade side Trade size Trade price Position net size Position average price Realized PL Effect

obligations_proposed.statement: For instrument types configured for Weighted Average, Average Price, Open PL, and Realized PL during cash settlement (non-equity cash flow) follow the weighted-average algorithm in CRT-1738.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: Average Price, Open PL and Realized PL during cash settlement ... calculated by weighted average

obligations_proposed.statement: Realized P/L for each closing trade must be calculated from average position price, not from matched opening-trade prices.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: PL for each closing trade ... should be calculated based on average position price and not the opening price of the matched opening trades

obligations_proposed.statement: Only opening trades contribute to position average price for WeightedAvg cash settlement.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: Only opening trades contributes to position average price

obligations_proposed.statement: After position net size returns to zero, subsequent opening trades start a fresh average-price window (ladder examples 3a/3b, 5a/5b in CRT-1738).
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: Example ... from the moment the position was flat (zero size)

obligations_proposed.statement: For FIFO-calculated instruments, average position fill price is the weighted average by trades contributing to the currently open net position under FIFO rules.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: For FIFO-calculated instruments: weighted average by trades contributing to the currently open net position by FIFO

obligations_proposed.statement: For WeightedAvg-calculated instruments, average fill price uses weighted average of all opening trades since the position last crossed zero net size.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: For WeightedAvg-calculated instruments: weighted average by all opening trades since last crossing 0

obligations_proposed.statement: Functional configuration must map instrument types to FIFO vs WeightedAvg valuation; FOREX with FX_SPOT subtype uses Weighted Average; STOCKS, ETF, OPTION, CFD families remain FIFO unless explicitly migrated.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: FIFO: STOCKS, ETF, OPTION, CFD... Weighted Average: FOREX (FX_SPOT subtype)

obligations_proposed.statement: When valuation method is not configured for an instrument type, FIFO is the default.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: If not configured, FIFO method is used by default.

obligations_proposed.statement: Scenarios that reconfigure valuation method for already-existing instrument types may be skipped in regression scope.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: configuration is not going to be changed for already existing instrument types: such test scenarios can be skipped

obligations_proposed.statement: For FIFO-calculated instruments, % P/L Gross equals (Open PL / ABS(SUM(open cost * multiplier))) * 100.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: For FIFO-calculated instruments : (Open PL / ABS(SUM (open cost * multiplier))) * 100

obligations_proposed.statement: For WeightedAvg-calculated instruments, % P/L Gross equals (Open PL / ABS(SUM(average price x qty * multiplier))) * 100.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: For WeightedAvg-calculated instruments: (Open PL / ABS( SUM (average price x qty * multiplier))) * 100

obligations_proposed.statement: For FIFO-calculated instruments, Open P/L equals (position_qty * mark price - open cost) * multiplier, where open cost sums costs of FIFO-remaining opening trades.
obligations_proposed.evidence_anchor: For FIFO-calculated instruments : (position_qty * mark price - open cost) * multiplier

obligations_proposed.statement: For WeightedAvg-calculated instruments, Open P/L equals position_qty * (mark price - average fill price) * multiplier.
